tone: Soft gatherable plant read (herb, berry leaf, fiber plant); hopeful, not neon loot.

BaseColor.notes: Herb green default. Berry fruit / flower accents via instance BaseColor only.

Roughness.notes: Leaves matte; berry skin slightly glossier.

Variation.notes: Cluster breakup so gather nodes read without UI scream.

NightMix.notes: Cool plant wash. Spirit-seed night crop → switch to M_Nurtured instance, not a second herb set.

Emissive.notes: Usually off. Soft interact hint only if AD approves; prefer gameplay FX over material glow.

allowed_instance_tweaks: BaseColor for RES_HERB / RES_BERRY / RES_FIBER leaf accents
forbidden: Extra resource materials beyond six canon resources
cite_on_meshes: poultice / bowl stored plant parts (tint only)
